name: brass_low
character: Low brass in short, stacked stabs from behind the listener: the mass of the hole arriving as weight, never as a melody.
description: The weight: brass section on low D/A/Eb voicings, short marcato stabs on section turns and on the crush, long held swells under the dilation.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring section 1 | very low, very loud brass is the cue's sense of size; it lands on the turning points, not on every bar
KB soundfont-velocity-and-realism section 4 | the marcato stabs are brighter than the swells, which velocity_timbre encodes per note; starting values
ESTIMATE: azimuth 152 deg behind and right, 3.0 m, gain -7 dB, LP 6 kHz are starting values for a section heard from the far side of the field
